author: Ronove
quote: You can't run over civilians during protests; the car brakes automatically. If you get out and try to shoot them, they're invincible. You can't visit prostitutes either. If you try to attack a woman, three or four men suddenly spawn out of nowhere to defend her. You can't attack certain types of NPCs, and to steal a car, you have to use the scanner. You can't even walk around in your underwear because your clothes magically appear on you. It's everything GTA should NOT be, and everything GTA has always stood for has been taken away. But hey, they've added the ability to do laundry and go grocery shopping. I genuinely don't understand why nobody has the intellectual honesty to admit that this is a disappointment and has absolutely nothing to do with what GTA has always represented. If I wanted to play a life simulator, I certainly wouldn't buy GTA. I'd go play The Sims or INZOI instead. To me, this is a massive disappointment. Honestly, I couldn't care less how amazing the graphics are or how good the game looks.

I've never experienced something like this with other games that have been DDOS attacked.Congratulations, and goodbye forever
